description: Your model returned almost-JSON? Send the raw text, get valid JSON back plus the list of every fix. No extra key or account needed. Handles ```json fences and chatty text around the JSON, trailing or missing commas, single and smart quotes, unquoted keys, comments, Python True/None, NaN, raw newlines in strings and output cut off mid-string (closed cleanly). Optional JSON Schema (draft 2020-12/2019-09/07) check with exact error paths, plus safe coercion ("42" -> 42, "true" -> true, value -> [value]). Nothing stored, ~1-25 ms. For AI agents, LLM apps, n8n/Make flows and backend payload checks. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/json-repair-validate.
